message.content:
Unified memory matters because the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine all draw from a single shared memory pool, so the entire model can stay resident without being split or copied across separate device memories. This lets you load models far larger than any single component's dedicated memory would allow, which is essential for running full-weight LLMs locally. It also avoids expensive data round-trips between separate memory spaces, keeping the inference pipeline efficient.

Concrete number: Apple Silicon supports up to **1 TB** of unified memory (M2 Ultra), enabling local inference of large models like 70B-parameter weights.
